title: Hearty Umami Middle Eastern Tofu Fattoush
description: A creamy and comforting Middle Eastern dish featuring tofu, sherry vinegar, and dashi extract, perfect for a satisfying meal. This ovo-vegetarian friendly recipe is a twist on the classic fattoush salad.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Toss the cubed tofu with a tablespoon of olive oil, salt, and pepper, and bake for 20 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the sherry vinegar, dashi extract, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Add the toasted pita bread pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the dressing.
In a separate bowl, combine the mixed greens, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and red onion.
In a small bowl, whisk together the remaining olive oil and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Drizzle the olive oil mixture over the greens mixture and toss to coat.
To assemble the salad, add the baked tofu, pita bread pieces, and crumbly feta cheese to the greens mixture and toss gently.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then serve immediately.
